title: Add AppDatabase
description: Room database singleton wiring together the three entities and their DAOs, with exportSchema enabled and a thread-safe lazily-initialized companion object accessor, following the same singleton pattern used in the reference app Goblin Loot Engine's AppDatabase.
acceptance_criteria: @Database annotation lists entities = [Profile::class, Medication::class, DoseLog::class], version = 1, exportSchema = true
abstract class AppDatabase : RoomDatabase() with abstract fun profileDao(): ProfileDao, medicationDao(): MedicationDao, doseLogDao(): DoseLogDao

companion object holds a @Volatile nullable INSTANCE and a getDatabase(context: Context): AppDatabase function using double-checked synchronized locking and Room.databaseBuilder with database name "med_timing_tracker_database"
